Console: Construct a new `Console`. By default, output is written through `bare-logger` (<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-logger>), or `bare-system-logger` (<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-system-logger>) on Android.
error: Forward `data` to the corresponding method on the backend.
time: Start a timer identified by `label` (default `'default'`). Warns if a timer with the same label is already running.
timeLog: Log the elapsed time for the timer identified by `label` (default `'default'`), along with any additional `data`. Output uses milliseconds for short durations and seconds beyond one second.
timeEnd: Log the elapsed time and remove the timer identified by `label` (default `'default'`).
count: Increment and log the counter identified by `label` (default `'default'`).
trace: Log a stack trace prefixed with the formatted `data`.
assert: If `condition` is falsy, log `data` prefixed with `'Assertion failed'`. Otherwise do nothing.
table: Render `tabularData` as a table. Arrays and plain objects use an `(index)` column; `Map` and `Set` use an `(iteration index)` column with `key` and `values` (or `values` only) headers. Pass `properties` to restrict which object keys are shown as columns; the argument is ignored for `Map` and `Set`. Values that aren't tabular (primitives, `null`, functions) fall back to `console.log(tabularData)`.
